question: What has Accenture reported most recently, and what is its outlook for fiscal 2027?
grading: Reference-free (no fixed answer), graded for recency and support. Expect the agent to identify the 2026-10-01 release (fiscal year ended 2026-08-31): Q4 revenue USD 18.68B (+6% USD, +7% local currency) above the guided USD 17.75B-18.40B; FY2026 revenue about USD 74.2B; FY2027 outlook revenue growth 3%-6% in local currency and GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81. Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; later runs may have newer developments. Must cite dated sources and not present superseded (June 2026) figures as current.
answer: As of 2026-10-03 the most recent Accenture development is its fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 2026 results released October 1, 2026 (year ended August 31, 2026): Q4 revenues USD 18.68 billion (+6% in USD, +7% in local currency), above the guided USD 17.75-18.40 billion; Q4 new bookings USD 22.17 billion; full-year revenues USD 74.2 billion (+6% USD, +5% local currency) and GAAP diluted EPS USD 13.56 (adjusted USD 13.97). Fiscal 2027 outlook: revenue growth of 3% to 6% in local currency, operating margin 15.9%-16.1%, GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81, free cash flow USD 11.0-11.8 billion and at least USD 9.5 billion of capital return; Q1 FY2027 revenue guided to USD 18.95-19.60 billion. [T15-E1, T15-E2]

output.answer:
## Most recent report: Q4 & full-year fiscal 2026 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026; reported Oct 1, 2026)

**Q4 FY2026**
- Revenue: **$18.68B**, up 6% in USD / 7% in local currency — above the guided range of $17.75–18.40B
- GAAP diluted EPS: **$3.29** (+46%), beating consensus of ~$3.18
- Bookings: **$22.17B**, up 4% YoY, including a record **141** client bookings of $100M+
- Free cash flow: $2.8B for the quarter

**Full-year FY2026**
- Revenue: **$74.18B**, up 6% USD / 5% local currency (above prior 3–4% LC guidance)
- GAAP diluted EPS $13.56 (+12%); **adjusted EPS $13.97** (+8%)
- Free cash flow: **$11.62B**
- Record **$11.5B** returned to shareholders (+38%), including $7.5B of buybacks
- Dividend raised 5% to **$1.71**/quarter (payable Nov 13, 2026)

CEO Julie Sweet highlighted "broad-based growth," the record $100M+ bookings, and AI demand (400+ clients starting their first advanced AI work in FY26; ~110,000 AI/data professionals).

Market reaction: shares jumped **~22%** — the stock's largest single-day gain on record — after a rough 2026 in which ACN had fallen ~40% amid AI-disruption fears and a US federal business slump.

## Fiscal 2027 outlook

| Metric | Guidance |
|---|---|
| Revenue growth (local currency) | **3%–6%** (incl. ~2–2.5% inorganic) |
| GAAP diluted EPS | **$14.39–$14.81** (+6–9% vs. FY26 GAAP; +3–6% vs. adjusted) |
| Q1 FY2027 revenue | **$18.95B–$19.60B** (2–6% LC; ~-1% FX) |
| Operating margin | 15.9%–16.1% (+10–30 bps vs. adjusted FY26) |
| Effective tax rate | 24.5%–26.5% |
| Operating cash flow / FCF | $11.9–12.7B / $11.0–11.8B |
| Capital return | **At least $9.5B** |
| Acquisitions | ~**$5B** planned (after $4.9B in FY26) |

**Key assumptions/caveats:** a dynamic macro backdrop with continued competitive pricing pressure, and an annualized **~$1B Middle East headwind** (top of the range assumes no growth in that business, bottom allows further deterioration). The upper end assumes stable-to-slightly-improving discretionary spending; the lower end allows for deterioration. Management expects the US federal business to contribute meaningfully again in FY27, and continues to view AI as a net growth tailwind.

The 3–6% LC revenue guide's midpoint sits **above** analysts' ~3.9% consensus, which drove the rally.

Sources:

- [Reuters: Accenture's strong annual forecast sparks rally in IT consulting stocks](https://www.reuters.com/business/accenture-forecasts-annual-revenue-growth-above-estimates-2026-10-01)
- [Accenture Q4 2026 earnings beat sends stock up 22% (Yahoo Finance)](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-q4-2026-earnings-beat-172435987.html)
- [Accenture Q4 FY2026 earnings call transcript (Investing.com)](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-accenture-tops-q4-2026-forecasts-shares-jump-178-93CH-4927565)
